_about: Licences reviewed for the core track (core/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md). tools/ci/check_licences.py fails CI when a dependency's licence cannot be met from this list. Add an identifier only after reading its text and checking it against the rule: nothing linked into the apps stronger than MPL-2.0; the server may use AGPL-compatible licences.

apps.MPL-2.0: file-level copyleft, the ceiling for the apps (UniFFI runtime)

allo-isolate.why: its Cargo.toml declares none; its LICENSE file is Apache-2.0 (read 6 November 2026)

androidOnly._about: Licences reviewed for the Android and Wear OS apps only (android/THIRD_PARTY_LICENSES.md), never for the core or the server; check_licences.py does not read this section, which records the review. Stage W1, 27 November 2026.
androidOnly.LicenseRef-Android-SDK-License: Google Play services client libraries (play-services-wearable 20.0.1 and the base, basement and tasks libraries it brings), under Google's Android Software Development Kit License (developer.android.com/studio/terms), as their POMs declare. Closed source but not copyleft; the owner approved Play services for the Wear OS link (mock-up 50, 27 November 2026). An F-Droid build, if one ever comes, leaves them out.
